note: string-carrier path from #93490. Fresh start sends messages[1] as ARRAY with one text block plus cache_control {type: ephemeral, ttl: 1h}. Fable --resume replays the same 26285 chars as a plain string with no cache_control, so the prompt-cache prefix busts.

paths.rule: fresh start: content is ARRAY with one text block + cache_control {type: ephemeral, ttl: 1h}
resume: content is a PLAIN STRING, same text/length (26285 chars), NO cache_control
opus --model opus resumes HIT; fable --model fable resumes MISS every time
